title: Come the Rich and Come the Poor
description: Come the Rich and Come the Poor in Tonic Solfa to VIENNA, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Bowring wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 973 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"The rich and poor meet together."”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to VIENNA; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Come the rich and come the poor, To the Chris-tian tem-ple door; Let their min-gled prayers as-cend To the u-ni-ver-sal Friend.
